root_idea.summary: The root centers on filling a vessel or bounded domain and being full, with extensions to capacity, fullness of states, abundance, and the prominence of a gathered group.
root_idea.development: The lexical range develops from concrete filling and fullness to measures of capacity, figurative fullness or sufficiency, and descriptions of prominent people or assemblies whose presence fills the eye or commands regard.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form I citation form مَلَأَ.
Displayed under the normalized Form VIII citation form اِمْتَلَأَ.
Displayed under the singular active-participle citation form مَالِئٌ.
Displayed as the collective noun مَلَأٌ.
Displayed as the measure noun مِلْءٌ.

senses.usage_conditions: Used transitively for filling a recipient or domain; the same lexical use also appears in the passive as being filled. Quranic contexts include filling a realm or group and being filled with something.

senses.definition: To become full; to fill up.
senses.usage_conditions: Intransitive: the subject itself reaches fullness or becomes filled.

senses.definition: One who fills; filling or causing something to become full.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic plural is used predicatively with an understood object, describing those who fill something.

senses.definition: An assembly or collective body gathered around a common view or purpose.
senses.usage_conditions: The term can emphasize the gathered body as a visually impressive or dignified collective; in the Quran it may denote an assembly in general.

senses.definition: The leading people of a community: nobles, chiefs, princes, or other principal persons whose opinions are respected.
senses.usage_conditions: In Quranic usage, the collective commonly refers to the influential people surrounding a ruler or community, rather than to an undifferentiated crowd.

senses.definition: A quantity sufficient to fill a vessel or bounded space; a full measure or capacity.
senses.usage_conditions: Used in measure and construct expressions for what fills a receptacle or other defined extent.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To satisfy or glut the eye by the comeliness of someone's appearance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the construction مَلَأَ العَيْنَ and related expressions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become rich, wealthy, solvent, or well provided for.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A distinct intransitive use of the Form I root.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a word or saying, to be so gross or abominable that it fills the mouth and impedes articulation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic figurative construction describing an utterance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be filled with fright.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative passive construction with an emotion as the complement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To sprinkle or bespatter another's clothes with mud or similar matter; of a camel, to bespatter its rider with ejected cud.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic use recorded for the verb in specialized constructions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make or urge a mount to run vehemently.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A fixed construction with عِنَانٌ as its complement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be afflicted with the disease called مُلَاءَة.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized medical use, distinct from the ordinary meaning of being filled.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make a horse run at the utmost rate of the pace called حُضْر.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized Form II equestrian construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To aid or assist someone and conform with him in doing something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Usually constructed with عَلَى and an undertaking or action.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pull a bow to the utmost.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized Form IV construction concerning the force of drawing a bow.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause someone to be afflicted with the disease called مُلَاءَة.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized causative medical construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become full, including becoming full of food or drink, rage, or satiety.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The complement may be nourishment or an inner state; these are extensions of becoming filled rather than separate grammatical forms.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To put on oneself a مُلَاءَة, a covering or drapery.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A distinct specialized use of the Form V verb with a garment as its object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To agree or conspire together to do something; to aid and conform with one another in it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal Form VI construction, commonly with عَلَى and the matter undertaken.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become full of the sap, vigor, or bloom of youth; by extension, to become plump.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or extended Form VIII use describing bodily vigor or fullness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For the utmost of one's power or ability to be accomplished.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative construction in which capacity is understood as fully realized.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To arrange one's debt through wealthy or solvent persons made one's debtors.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare and textually uncertain Form X usage; the reported readings and interpretation are not uniform.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Consultation or deliberation leading to consent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional figurative use of the assembly noun, especially in expressions for deciding an affair together.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Opinion or judgment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A lexical extension associated with the counsel of an assembly.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Disposition, nature, manners, or a person's store of needful qualities.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of character and conduct, including the plural expression for good manners.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Coveting or desire for something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare nominal meaning recorded separately from assembly and counsel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Tremulousness, flabbiness, and swelling of a camel's flesh caused by prolonged confinement after a journey.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized veterinary term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The manner or degree in which a thing is filled.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Distinct from مِلْءٌ as a measure of capacity; it describes the state or manner of filling.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An oppression or bodily distress caused by repletion with food.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A medical or physiological specialization.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Richness, wealth, or abundance of means.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal extension of fullness and sufficiency.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Trustworthiness or honesty.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An alternative lexical value recorded for the same noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A rich, solvent, capable, or trustworthy person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The adjective may foreground wealth, ability to discharge obligations, or reliability; these are lexical alternatives rather than a restriction to one social class.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Chiefs, understood as people rich in the qualities needed for leadership.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A substantivized plural-related use distinct from the ordinary adjective meaning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A defluxion or rheum caused by repletion, with heaviness in the head.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized medical noun associated with overfilling of the stomach.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A piece of drapery or covering wrapped around the body, traditionally formed of two oblong pieces of cloth sewn together.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A garment noun; its plural or collective forms are also recorded in the lexical evidence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Fairness or beauty of complexion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative construction using the garment noun for an appearance that clothes or suffuses the person with beauty.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Simple dust.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare specialized meaning recorded in the lexical entry.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The skim that forms on the surface of milk.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized material noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Full, especially said of a vessel or similar receptacle; figuratively, full of generosity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The figurative complement may be an abstract quality such as generosity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A majestic or comely person whose appearance satisfies the eye.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative active-participle use centered on visual impressiveness, not on filling a container.

other_classical_meanings.definition: More satisfying or pleasing, especially to the eye; hence better or more suitable for someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A comparative form used of appearance or of an option judged more satisfactory.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Filled.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The ordinary passive-participial adjective of مَلَأَ, distinct from the Quranic finite verb group.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Afflicted with the disease called مُلَاءَة.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized medical interpretation of the adjective.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An ewe whose belly contains water and matter, making her appear pregnant.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized livestock description.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A youth in the full bloom of age.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative participial description of mature youthful fullness.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Idiomatic saying that fills the mouth.
Quranic fill construction used as an example of the ordinary filling sense.
Drawing a bow to the utmost.
Becoming full of food and drink.
Becoming full, also attested in the Quranic Form VIII group.
Fullness of vigor, youth, or bodily fullness.
Full accomplishment of power or ability.
Rare debt-related Form X construction retained with its uncertainty.
Capacity or quantity filling a receptacle.
A stone filling the hand illustrates bounded capacity.
A measure extending over a defined domain.
Construct expression for what fills a covering.
Rich, solvent, capable, or trustworthy person.
Comparative construction with an affair or option.
Alternative derivational explanation of the same disease use.

cautions: The QAC Form I group contains active surfaces transcribed as أَمْلَأَ alongside passive forms, while its canonical morphology identifies the group as Form I; the public headword is therefore normalized to the classical citation form مَلَأَ and the QAC Form I identity is retained.
The rare Form X debt expression is preserved, but its lexical interpretation is explicitly uncertain in the supplied evidence.
